protocol.dataset: UCI Online Retail II, UK positive non-cancelled transactions
protocol.cohort: training active-day quartiles, stable seeded hash; 300 pool, first 100 stratified IDs

tuning.selection: minimum validation WAPE; tie by trial order

protocol.final: one reserved 28-day test per architecture and prespecified seed; no retuning
protocol.resource_scope: whole fresh worker process, two CPU threads; sequential jobs
limitations: sales, not latent demand; availability unknown
pilot excluded by SKU, shared dates; no fully external retailer test
synthetic scenarios use historical factors; no future promotion causal claim

preprocessing.availability: not recorded by UCI; sales are observed transactions, not uncensored latent demand
preprocessing.price_fill: chronological forward-fill only; leading unknown prices set to zero
